summary: This Form 8-K reports the sale of unregistered equity securities by Goldman Sachs Private Credit Corp. under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. Approximately 6.1 million Class I shares were sold for $149.8M, and 18,109 Class S shares for $0.4M, based on subscription agreements with accredited investors. The filing also discloses the June 2026 regular distribution of $0.1850 per share across share classes and total return metrics. This is a routine capital raise and distribution disclosure, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate event is involved.
